## SnapSort 1.2.1 — Swipe to clean

**New: Swipe to clean.** Go through your screenshots one card at a time. Swipe left to delete, right to keep, up to favorite.

- Start it from **Clean up**, or tap the swipe button on any app's page to sweep through just that app.
- Changed your mind? Tap undo to bring the last card back.
- Nothing is deleted while you swipe. At the end you see how many you marked and how much space they take, then delete them all in one go, or review them first.
- Screenshots you keep are remembered, so next time you pick up where you left off.

**Fixed**
- Now installs on every Android phone, including 32-bit ones like the Samsung Galaxy A10.
- Deleting works on Android 10: SnapSort asks for storage access the first time, and tells you if a delete didn't go through.

Updating? Just install over the old version — your albums and favorites stay.
